feeding_claim.verbatim: Our herds range on pastures of Guinea Grass and a range of clovers.

farmers_markets: Volcano Farmers Market, Cooper Center (Sundays 6am to 9am)
notes: Family ranch in Kau on the Big Island. Checked 2026-11-15: homepage, the beef page and the feed store page. The homepage says the herds range on Guinea grass and clover pastures and shows 100% next to grass-fed beef, with no finishing statement, so the category is grass-fed. Retail cuts are sold at the ranch's Feed Store in Naalehu (weekdays 10 to 5, Sunday 11 to 3, closed Saturday; call for prices), which also sells feed and ranch supplies. The beef page lists a stand at the Volcano Farmers Market at Cooper Center on Sundays 6 to 9am, Whole Foods (Oahu), Foodland and Sack and Save stores, and three restaurants. The beef page mentions GAP Step 4 certification; not checked on the certifier listing, so not added. No bulk shares, online ordering or shipping found.
